title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.0 — Return of the Ancients: New League, Runes of Aldur and Endgame Rework
summary: 0.5.0 was the 0.5 series content update: a new League, Runes of Aldur systems, the Endgame rework, new Ascendancies, skills, items and systems. A returning-player entry, not a notes mirror.
description: The 0.5.0 big-version and returning-player entry. It explains what changed at a high level, links the system pages, and lists what later 0.5.x patches modified.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Runes and Soul Cores, the signature system of the 0.5.0 Return of the Ancients update

sections.title: Player impact in 30 seconds
paragraphs: 0.5.0 was the 0.5 series content update: a new League, the Runes of Aldur systems, the Endgame rework, new Ascendancies, skills, items and systems.
It is the starting page for returning players who skipped the 0.5 cycle. It does not copy the official changelog verbatim.
Later 0.5.1 to 0.5.4e patches modified parts of what 0.5.0 introduced, so each system page cites the version it was last verified against.

versions.summary: Return of the Ancients: new League, Runes of Aldur, Endgame rework, Ascendancies and systems on this page.
Atlas passives, Lineage Support and Runes QoL extending 0.5.0.
Endgame, Delirium and Runes reward tuning on top of 0.5.0.
Runes of Aldur Expedition Atlas and new items extending the 0.5.0 systems.

cards.detail: Return of the Ancients introduced a new League and quest flow for returning players.
Runes of Aldur is a new system spanning Atlas, Items and Builds; it needs its own pages.
The Endgame was reworked; old mapping and Atlas knowledge no longer applies.
New Ascendancies, skills and items expand Build choices; old tier lists are stale.

sections.newText: Read this 0.5.0 overview, then your class Build page, then the 0.5.x page for the content you care about.

items.question: What is 0.5.0 in one line?
answer: The 0.5 series content update: a new League, Runes of Aldur, the Endgame rework and new class options.
It is the returning-player entry point, not a mirror of the official notes.

items.question: Do I need to read the later 0.5.x pages too?
answer: Yes. 0.5.1 to 0.5.4e modified parts of what 0.5.0 introduced.
Each system page states the version it was last verified against.

issues.text: Several 0.5.0 system pages are still in reviewing/queued as later patches are reconciled.
Old pre-0.5 Build tier lists are invalid and marked for rewrite.
